options.text: The number of notebooks in a job
The number of files in a Delta table
The number of partitions Spark uses when shuffling data for joins and aggregations

questions.explanation: It sets the default number of partitions after a shuffle. Adaptive query execution can coalesce them at run time.

options.text: How many joins a query may have
How long a broadcast variable lives
The size below which AQE switches a sort merge join to a broadcast hash join at run time

questions.explanation: It's the size threshold for switching a sort merge join to a broadcast hash join at run time (30MB by default).

questions.stem: Which feature adjusts shuffle partitions and join strategies while a query runs, based on real data sizes?
questions.explanation: AQE re-optimizes at run time: it coalesces partitions, switches join strategies and handles skew.

questions.stem: After a shuffle, AQE finds many tiny partitions. What can it do at run time?

options.text: Rewrite the source table on disk with fewer files
Add more executors to the cluster
Raise spark.sql.shuffle.partitions for the rest of the job
Coalesce them into fewer, larger partitions

questions.explanation: AQE dynamically coalesces partitions after a shuffle, so small partitions are combined.

questions.stem: Which two problems can AQE handle at run time? Each correct answer is a complete solution.
questions.explanation: AQE coalesces small partitions and splits skewed ones; it can't fix missing objects, syntax or permissions.
